title: cardamine hirsuta subsp. sylvatica
intro: Cardamine hirsuta subsp. sylvatica, commonly known as woodland bittercress, is a plant species within the family Brassicaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Cardamine hirsuta subsp. sylvatica are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and vasodilatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
